sources.page_date: Updated April 14, 2026 (as stated on the page)
supports: Special Links must include the Associates tag as a URL parameter (Participation Requirements, 2(b))
Prices and availability may only be shown via Amazon-served links or Creators API / PA API (Participation Requirements, 2(b))
Customer reviews and star ratings may only be displayed if obtained via Creators API / PA API (Participation Requirements, 3(t))
No cloaking, hiding or obscuring of the URL containing Special Links, including by Redirecting Links (3(v))
No link-shortening that makes it unclear you are linking to an Amazon Site (3(w))
The Site must not have price tracking or price alerting functionality (3(y))
Associates must comply with applicable disclosure law, naming the U.S. FTC Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising as an example (Responsibility for Your Site, 3(b))

Automated agents may only interact with Program Content if they identify themselves in the user agent as 'Agent/[agent name]', do not conceal that they are agents, and do not circumvent blocking measures (IP License, Agent Terms)
ASINs may be stored indefinitely for use with the Program (IP License, 2(h))
quotes: you must include your Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site

your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API

You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API
You will not cloak, hide, spoof, or otherwise obscure the URL of your Site containing Special Links (including by use of Redirecting Links)
You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.
Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.
No Agent may access, use, or interact with Program Content unless, at all times, it identifies itself
In all HTTP/HTTPS requests, identify that the request is from an Agent and disclose the name of the Agent by including the following in the request's user agent string: “Agent/[agent name]”
you may store individual Amazon Standard Identification Numbers (ASINs) for an indefinite period until the termination of this License

sources.title: Why doesn't my tracking ID appear in your URL after a visitor clicks through to Amazon from my Web site?
supports: Amazon states it is not necessary for the tracking ID to appear in the URL after the click-through, because the shopping session is tagged for attribution
This means the absence of a tag= parameter in an observed redirect is NOT by itself evidence that a link is untracked
It does not confirm attribution for the specific supplied short links; that still requires an Associates report
quotes: We understand your concern, but rest assured that it is not necessary for your unique ID to appear in order for us to track sales made after the initial clickthrough. The individual shopping session will be tagged in a way that allows us to track the items purchased and credit you with the appropriate commission.

sources.title: How do I build a simple text link to a specific item on Amazon?
supports: Amazon's own documented simple text-link format is /dp/ASIN with the Associates tag supplied as a URL parameter
Amazon defines ASIN as the 10-digit code used to denote specific products
This is the format used for every outbound product link built by this site
quotes: http://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN/ref=nosim?tag=YOURASSOCIATEID
ASIN: ASIN is the 10-digit code that Amazon uses to denote specific products. It is short for "Amazon.com Standard Item Number." Every item in our catalog has a unique ASIN.
YOURASSOCIATEID: YOURASSOCIATEID is the unique ID that is used to identify your Associates account, automatically generated when you apply for the Associates Programme.
